title: Edin a Wɔde Ma Ansa na Wɔrewo
intro: Fa w’adwene bu kronkronbea bi a ɛhɔ yɛ dinn a nkotɔsrɛ a anibere wom ahyɛ mu ma wɔ mfe pii a yɛde atwɛn akyi no ho mfonini. Mmuae bi a ekura din a wɔmfa mmae da, a ɛhyɛ nyansa a efi mmofraase ne asetra a ahofama, ayamhyehye, ne ahotew ahyɛ no agyirae no fi nea wonhu mu ba.
clues: Allah ankasa na ɔtoo me din ansa na wɔrewo me, a na wɔamfa din amma obiara da.
Awofo a wɔn mfe akɔ anim a wosusuwii sɛ mma rentumi nyɛ yiye no maa me kwan sɛ nkotɔsrɛ a anibere wom ho mmuae.
Wɔmaa me nyansa, atemmu, ne Kyerɛwnsɛm no bere a na meda so ara yɛ abofra.
Ná meyɛ m’awofo ho asɛyɛde na na mewɔ ayamhyehye ma afoforo, na na menyɛ ahantan anaa asoɔdenfo.
Allah hyɛɛ asomdwoeɛ baa me so da a wɔwoo me, da a mɛwu, ne da a wɔbɛnyan me nkwa mu.
M’agya Zakariyya nyaa me ho asɛmpa no fii abɔfo hɔ bere a na ogyina hɔ wɔ mpaebɔ mu wɔ kronkronbea (mihrab).

outcome.answer: Asomdwoe nka me da a wɔwoo me, da a mewu ne da a wobenyan me nkwa mu

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
